meta.name: block-no-verify-hook
meta.description: Configure a PreToolUse hook to prevent AI agents from skipping git pre-commit hooks with --no-verify and other bypass flags. Use when setting up Claude Code projects that enforce commit quality gates.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拦住 AI 绕开提交检查的行为,让每次提交都过质量门禁
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果担心 AI 助手用 --no-verify 跳过提交检查,想让质量门禁强制生效。
copy.tagline_en: Block AI agents from bypassing commit checks so every commit passes the gate
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you worry AI assistants skip commit checks with --no-verify and want the gate enforced.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 的 Bash 命令只要带 --no-verify、--no-gpg-sign 等绕过旗标,就会在执行前被拦截并返回 BLOCKED 提示;普通命令照常运行。
howto.when: 在你为 Claude Code 项目配置提交质量门槛时使用;当 Claude 试图执行带绕过旗标的 git 命令时,hook 会拦下该次调用。

say.text: 改成全局配置,让所有项目都拦截 --no-verify

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude's Bash calls containing bypass flags such as --no-verify or --no-gpg-sign are rejected before running and return a BLOCKED message; other commands run normally.
howto.when_en: Use when configuring Claude Code projects that enforce commit quality gates; when Claude tries a git command carrying a bypass flag, the hook blocks that call.

say_en.text: Add this PreToolUse hook config to the project's .claude/settings.json
say_en.note: Bypass-flag commands are then blocked in that project

say_en.text: Make it global so every project blocks --no-verify
Test it: does git commit --no-verify -m test get blocked?
say_en.note: It should be blocked with a BLOCKED message
